name: Return to Jahan
label: Quest
description: You carry finished leather goods from Thunder Bluff back to Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads. The trip introduces travelers to the Horde’s wind rider…

clips.title: The story
paras: You carry finished leather goods from Thunder Bluff back to Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads. The trip introduces travelers to the Horde’s wind rider routes between Mulgore and the Barrens, after they bring hides to Ahanu, the skinner in Thunder Bluff.

Tal, the wind rider master on Thunder Bluff’s central mesa, arranges flights across central Kalimdor. For many travelers, this is their first ride on a trained wind rider. A rider can take you to another settlement once you have met its wind rider master, such as Devrak at the Crossroads. The beasts cross leagues that would otherwise mean a dangerous journey overland through the Red Rocks and northern Barrens.

Jahan Hawkwing trades from the Crossroads, where hunters, scouts, and mercenaries gather each day. The flight also carries goods between the settlements. Hides sent to Ahanu on Thunder Bluff’s high rises are made into durable armor and equipment, then flown back to the Barrens crossroads to supply the Horde’s growing frontier efforts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town. You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.
Speak with me again when you are ready. Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you are back from Thunder Bluff? Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahanu sent me finished products? Very good. There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively. I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.
Thank you for all your efforts, friend. I am in your debt.
